tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Body copy `ink` sits on it in both themes. Dark value is the grey-deep surface used by the dark color mode.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Card and panel background one step off `surface`. `ink` reads on it at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders on `surface` and `surface-subtle`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface` and `surface-subtle`. 12.6:1 on white, 11.4:1 on the dark surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines and captions on `surface`. 5.7:1 on white, 9.4:1 on dark. Use instead of `grey-medium`, which fails AA for text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on `surface`. Light value is `pink` (4.6:1 on white); dark value is `pink-light` (8.8:1 on the dark surface). Visited links keep this color.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover, focus and active on `surface`. Light value is `purple` (6.8:1 on white); dark value is `purple-light`.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Fills, buttons and accents; white text on it is 4.6:1. Not for text on the dark surface (2.8:1).

tokens.name: pink-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for `pink` fills; white text on it is 7.1:1.

tokens.name: pink-medium
tokens.usage: Mid-tone pink for decorative fills and chart marks. No text on it.

tokens.name: pink-light
tokens.usage: Pale pink tint for highlighted rows and badges, with `ink` text. Link color on the dark surface.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Secondary brand color and link hover. White text on it is 6.8:1.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Muted purple for borders and secondary fills.

tokens.name: purple-light
tokens.usage: Pale purple tint for highlights, with `ink` text. Link hover color on the dark surface.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Dark accent for footers and heavy headings on light surfaces. White text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: plum-light
tokens.usage: Pale plum tint for panels, with `ink` text.

tokens.name: plum-deep
tokens.usage: Darkest plum, for text-heavy dark bands. Vanishes against the dark surface; do not use as a block there.

tokens.name: royal-blue
tokens.usage: Deep blue accent and the bi-flag blue. White text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Info fills and chart blue. White text on it is 5.6:1.

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Info tint with `ink` text on light; the dark theme swaps in a saturated blue for stat tiles.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Tertiary accent for tags and chart marks. White text on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success. White text on it is 5.4:1. Pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: green-light
tokens.usage: Success tint with `ink` text on light; saturated green for stat tiles in the dark theme.

tokens.name: yellow-light
tokens.usage: Warning tint with `ink` text on light; saturated yellow for stat tiles in the dark theme.

tokens.name: yellow-deep
tokens.usage: Warning border and text accent on `yellow-light`. 5.0:1 on white, 4.5:1 on `yellow-light`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error and destructive actions. White text on it is 5.4:1. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: red-light
tokens.usage: Error tint with `ink` text on light; saturated red for stat tiles in the dark theme.

tokens.name: grey-light
tokens.usage: Light grey for table stripes and quiet panels; text color on the dark surface.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Neutral borders and disabled fills.

tokens.name: grey-medium
tokens.usage: Decorative neutral only: borders, icons, widget backgrounds in dark mode. 2.9:1 on white, so never body text.

tokens.name: grey-muted
tokens.usage: Raw muted grey. Prefer the `ink-muted` role token in layouts.

tokens.name: grey-deep
tokens.usage: Heavy neutral for headers and dark bands.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Page titles. Oswald, sentence or title case as the content has it.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy. Open Sans on a 16px base.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, bylines and table cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Most common border-radius in the theme: buttons, inputs, cards.
